_doc: CHARACTER ARSENAL CONTRACT (Tim, 2026-07-26): what each boss actually WIELDS, so a prompt can never ask a swordsman to shoot something. Every clip prompt is checked against this by scripts/check-prompt-coherence.mjs BEFORE it is fired, and rendered side-by-side with the anchor art in qa-boss/prompt-review.html. ROSTER LAW: this is a MELEE roster - every boss fights hand-to-hand with a carried weapon or their own body. NOTHING in this game launches, throws, fires or drops a separate object. Effects are allowed ONLY when they stay attached to the character or to the weapon he is holding.

universalBanned._why: These read as a projectile / detached prop regardless of character. hollow-pale special_3 v1 ('smoke SPIKE in front of him') rendered as a floating flaming object = 'one shoots a rocket' (Tim). hollow-pale throw_a v2 ('CLAMPS onto an unseen enemy') rendered the enemy as a brown ball in his fist.
phrases: in the air in front of

grabFraming._why: A SOLO clip that seizes an 'unseen enemy' makes the model PAINT the enemy as a visible object.
grabFraming.fix: Make it a self-contained gesture with NO target: rake / smash / barge / sweep THROUGH EMPTY AIR, claw open and empty, plus 'no object, no ball, nothing in his hand'.

requiredEffectAnchoring._why: An effect must be visibly PART OF the character or the weapon in his hand.

wields: left arm fused into a serrated BONE WING-SCYTHE
body: lower body is BLACK SMOKE, no legs
banned: dropping the weapon (it IS his arm)
a smoke shape that stands apart from him
hollow-pale.note: His smoke must ERUPT AROUND HIS OWN BODY. A smoke shape placed beside/in front of him renders as a rocket.

banned: any vertical blade hold (her katana crosses the top edge)

wields: large deep-crimson war-fan with hexagon-cut border
white paper talismans on his kasa hat
banned: a talisman placed loose in the air (must stay in his hand or on the fan)
ir48-hex-paper-lord.note: FINAL BOSS. His paper charms are the signature - keep them swirling AROUND HIM or pinched in his hand, never floating free.
